snippet.title: Frogs Aren't Fresh Demo Trailer | Wholesome Games Celebration
snippet.description: Frogs Aren't Fresh is a cozy, logic puzzle game, where you complete increasingly complex laundry orders! Take your time, and figure out the placement order to make sure everyone gets their clothes the way they like them. Try the demo now! https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames #puzzlegames #logicpuzzle #frogs
